no_identity_record.why_it_matters: device, proxy and identity-match signals are unobservable, not absent; a rule reading NULL as 'no new device' would clear new-device fraud

online_no_identity.what: online transactions with no identity record
online_no_identity.why_it_matters: an online purchase with no device record cannot be tested for card-not-present new-device fraud at all

no_billing_region.what: transactions with an empty billing region
no_billing_region.why_it_matters: out-of-region use and travel cannot be tested; a region rule must skip, not fire

dist_placeholder.why_it_matters: distance features are placeholders, not zero distance

risk_missing.why_it_matters: a missing score is not a low score

device_label_missing.what: January device profiles with no usable label

thin_cards.what: cards with fewer than 10 transactions in the whole dataset
thin_cards.why_it_matters: no stable baseline: amount, region and product comparisons are not meaningful

new_in_january.why_it_matters: the bank's model was not retrained and these cards have no pre-January baseline
